'''Ryden''' is in command of a group of [[Dragons]] in the [[Band of the Red Hand]].

== Activities ==
[[Dennel]] is about to give the order to destroy the Dragons before they are overrun by the [[Trolloc]] army inside [[Caemlyn]] when [[Talmanes Delovinde]] orders them to turn and fire on the walls. The Dragons blow a gaping hole in Caemlyn's wall and the Band manages to escape through it.
